clusters.name: crews-liveness-lock-fix
clusters.executionModeRationale: Serial. All three stories mutate the same crews plugin and US-003 touches the shared release stamps (6 version files), CHANGELOG.md, and the codexu AGENTS.md active-plugin-versions table; running them in parallel would conflict on those files. Implement US-001 -> (optional US-002) -> US-003 in one job.
